report_name: Google Patches Two Critical Use-After-Free Flaws in Chrome

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-84353
vulnerabilities.description: A critical use-after-free vulnerability in the Shared Tab Groups component of Google Chrome. A remote attacker could exploit this by luring a user to a malicious website, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-84352
vulnerabilities.description: A critical use-after-free vulnerability in the WebGL component of Google Chrome. An attacker could trigger this via a malicious website to manipulate memory and execute arbitrary code.

infrastructure.name: Malicious Website
infrastructure.description: A specially crafted website or HTML page designed to exploit use-after-free vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-84353, CVE-2026-84352) in vulnerable versions of Google Chrome.
